projects.title: Oud Al-Noor Signature Rigid Box
projects.description: Bespoke hand-wrapped rigid magnetic closure presentation box engineered for high-concentration Qatari artisanal oud oil and pure dehn al oud flacon.
projects.detailedStory: Crafted specifically for the luxury fragrance market in Qatar, this packaging combines 1400gsm Dutch greyboard with deep slate soft-touch velvet paper. The front flap integrates concealed neodymium magnets with a 0.2mm tolerance tactile closure snap. Finished with precision multi-level gold hot-foil stamping and custom-molded high-density EVA foam lined with black microsuede.
projects.packagingType: Book-Style Rigid Box with Neodymium Catch
projects.finishDetails: Matte Soft-Touch Lamination + 24k Gold Kurz Hot Foil Stamping + Blind Deboss Monogram

projects.title: Doha Single Origin Stand-Up Pouches
projects.description: High-barrier compostable multi-layer coffee pouches with Swiss-engineered degassing valves and custom tactile matte varnish.
projects.detailedStory: Designed to withstand Qatar’s high summer ambient temperatures while maintaining oxygen levels below 0.5%. We co-engineered an EVOH bio-barrier substrate that provides 18 months of fresh shelf life. The typography draws inspiration from Qatari maritime calligraphy paired with minimalist Scandinavian layout spacing.
projects.packagingType: Gusseted Stand-Up Pouch with Pocket Zipper
projects.finishDetails: Soft Matte Tactile Varnish + Registered Spot UV + Tear-Notch Sealing

projects.title: Al-Reem Desert Botanicals Skincare Suite
projects.description: Minimalist pharmaceutical-grade cosmetic carton collection with structural internal shock tabs for dropper bottles.
projects.detailedStory: A masterclass in restraint and sustainability. Utilizing 100% post-consumer FSC certified unbleached virgin pulp board with soy-based pantone inks. Each carton is machine die-cut with integrated crash-lock bottoms that withstand high-speed automated co-packaging lines in our Doha facility.
projects.packagingType: Reverse Tuck End Folding Carton with Custom Bottle Nest
projects.finishDetails: FSC 350gsm Nordic Paperboard + Water-based Silk Coating + Sculpted Micro-Deboss

projects.title: Royal Medjool Keepsake Hexagonal Hamper
projects.description: Architectural hexagonal luxury gift box designed for premium stuffed dates with gilded acrylic partitions and magnetic lid.
projects.detailedStory: Engineered for national day and Ramadan gifting across corporate Qatar. The geometric hexagonal geometry is reinforced with double-walled greyboard and wrapped in emerald green metallic buckram textured cloth. Gold foil typography highlights traditional geometric mashrabiya motifs reinterpreted for contemporary minimalist sensibilities.
projects.finishDetails: Embossed Buckram Paper + Gold Gilt Edging + Clear Food-Contact PET Tray

projects.title: Zero-Plastic Honeycomb Protective Mailers
projects.description: 100% recyclable expandable honeycomb paper padded envelopes replacing bubble wrap for Qatari online retailers.
projects.detailedStory: In alignment with Qatar National Vision 2030 environmental initiatives, Naspack developed an automated die-cut expandable honeycomb paper mailer. Features dual peel-and-seal tamper-evident adhesive strips for easy customer returns and water-resistant unbleached kraft exterior.
projects.finishDetails: 120gsm Unbleached Wet-Strength Kraft + Expandable Kraft Cushion Core

projects.title: National Dairy & Beverage Co-Packing System
projects.description: High-speed automated contract shrink-bundling, multi-pack promotional carton packaging and custom date-coding.
projects.detailedStory: Naspack manages secondary contract packaging and co-packing for FMCG distributors in Qatar. Operating cleanroom production lines with optical vision inspection, automated hot-melt glue cartoners, and bundle heat-tunnels running 120 units per minute with 99.98% quality compliance.
projects.packagingType: Multipack Secondary Sleeves & Corrugated Outer Trays
projects.finishDetails: B-Flute Corrugated Board + Flexographic High-Resolution 4-Color Print

projects.title: Maison Noir Truffle Sliding Drawer Box
projects.description: Matchbox-style slide-out rigid tray box with gold foil stamping and grosgrain ribbon pull-tab for handmade confectioneries.
projects.detailedStory: Engineered for luxury gourmet presentation, featuring an inner tray lined with grease-resistant glassine and 12 individual thermoformed gold-tinted cups. The outer sleeve incorporates a hidden anti-friction glide coating to ensure effortless opening feel.
projects.finishDetails: Soft Touch Charcoal Exterior + Metallic Gold Hot Foil + Custom Woven Pull Ribbon

projects.title: Al-Kassas Couture Garment Presentation Box
projects.description: Collapsible magnetic flat-pack luxury box engineered for bespoke bisht and evening couture preservation.
projects.detailedStory: Solves warehouse storage constraints for retail luxury boutiques while delivering uncompromised prestige upon unboxing. Stores flat at 8mm profile and pops into a 3D structural rigid box via 4 high-shear self-adhesive corner triangles.
projects.finishDetails: Pure Pearl White Uncoated 1200gsm Board + Subtle Embossed Monogram
